investigacion.base:
I couldn't open the three resolution sources directly, so the figures below come from secondary sources and snippets. Based on what's available today, the Dec 21–27 bar would most likely show somewhere around 200–400T tokens. That range is my own extrapolation, not a forecast.

**Resolution sources (as of Oct 10, 2026)**
- **OpenRouter rankings page:** The snippet says usage data runs through Oct 9, 2026. It also confirms the weekly bins, describing the week beginning Sep 28, 2026, which starts on a Monday.
- **Metaculus example screenshot:** The question text says the Sep 7–13 bar showed 127T.
- **Metaculus question 45689:** It opened Oct 6, 2026. I couldn't see its contents.

**Recent levels**
- **Week of Sep 14:** OpenRouter's own newsletter says weekly volume went from 0.5 trillion in the week of Jan 13, 2025 to 128.4 trillion in the week of Sep 14, 2026.
- **Week of Sep 28 (latest full week):** A third-party tracker built Oct 7 reports Weekly tokens (OpenRouter) 165.9T, with Token growth vs 4 weeks earlier 42.8%.
  - A big part of that jump looks like one stealth model. Space Bunny Alpha, an unnamed stealth model, processed 38.7 trillion tokens, 28.5% of the top 20, up 179%. Stealth models are usually free and temporary, so this volume could drop sharply when it launches publicly or is removed.
- **Earlier path:** 28.9T in the week of May 18–24 (28.9 trillion tokens in the week of May 18–24, 2026), about 25T at the late-May Series B, and over 90T by mid-2026. Volume has roughly doubled every 2–3 months but swings a lot from week to week. Agents made up roughly 71% of all token consumption by early August.

**Prediction markets (seen Oct 7, via predictmarketcap, a Kalshi/Polymarket aggregator)**
- **Oct 5–11 weekly market** ($19.2K volume): Above 162 T tokens 43% and Above 182 T tokens 29%. The market roughly expects this week to stay flat to slightly below the Sep 28 week.
- **October monthly market** (Sep 28–Oct 25, $11.3K volume, $8.3K liquidity): the quoted odds don't make sense together (Above 700T at 88% but Above 650T at 66%), so they're unreliable. They still suggest the market expects about 165–175T per week.

**Seasonality and timing**
- Dec 21–27 is Christmas week. Human usage will probably dip, but about 70% of tokens come from agents, which should soften the drop.
- No scheduled events are known before the resolution date. Unscheduled risks include new stealth or free models launching or ending (these have caused big swings before), new model releases, and OpenRouter changing how the chart is built.

**Extrapolation (not a forecast)**
- Keeping ~165T flat gives about 165T.
- 10–15% monthly growth from ~165T gives about 210–250T.
- The pace of the last 4 weeks (+43% per 4 weeks) would give over 450T.
- Mid-2025 to 2026 history suggests something like 1.5–2.5× over 12 weeks, which points to roughly 200–400T, minus a possible holiday dip.

**Sources:**

criterios: This question will resolve as the number of tokens used through OpenRouter during the week of December 21-27, 2026, as reported by the ["Top Models: Weekly usage of models across OpenRouter" graph](https://openrouter.ai/rankings#top-models).
letra_pequena:
The value displayed for the December 21 bar in the linked OpenRouter usage chart, including its displayed rounding, will be used for resolution. OpenRouter currently bins the chart into weeks running Monday through Sunday, so it is expected that a bar will cover December 21–27, 2026. If OpenRouter changes the bins to start on a different day, this question will resolve using the last full week falling within 2026.

For example, the equivalent question for September 7-13, 2026 would resolve to 127 trillion tokens:

![](https://cdn.metaculus.com/user_uploaded/Screenshot_2026-09-14_at_3.17.36PM.png)

***
This question's information (resolution criteria, fine print, background info, etc) is synced with an [original identical question](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/45689) which opened on 2026-10-06 17:00:00. This question will resolve based on the resolution criteria and fine print of the linked original question. However, if this question would resolve differently than the original question, then this question will be annulled. Additionally, if the original question's resolution could have been known before this question opened, then this question will be annulled.
razonamientos:
(a) **Time left:** The Dec 21–27 bar will be complete and readable around Dec 28, 2026, about 11 weeks from today (Oct 10, 2026).

(b) **If nothing changed:** The latest full week (Sep 28) showed about 166T tokens, so the bar would read about 160–170T. Part of that level comes from a temporary free stealth model, "Space Bunny Alpha," at about 38.7T.

(c) **If the current trend continued:**
- Volume went from about 29T in late May to about 128T in mid-September and about 166T at the end of September.
- At the recent pace of +43% per 4 weeks, the week would exceed 450T.
- A more modest 1.5–2× over 12 weeks gives about 250–330T before any holiday dip.

(d) **Markets:** Kalshi and Polymarket expect roughly flat volume near term, about 160–175T per week for October. These are thin markets, so I treat them as weak evidence.

(e) **Low scenario:** The stealth model ends or launches as a paid model, removing about 35–40T. Free-tier abuse controls or the loss of a large agentic customer remove more. Christmas week cuts usage another 10–15%. Together that gives about 120–140T.

(f) **High scenario:** New cheap frontier or open-weight models launch, or a new free stealth model arrives. Agentic coding volume keeps compounding at summer rates, and the holiday dip is small because agents dominate usage. That gives 400T or more.

**Forecast:** I center on modest growth from a base of about 150T once the stealth model is excluded. Growth of 1.4–1.6× over 12 weeks, less about 8% for the holiday, gives a median of roughly 215T. I keep the intervals wide given how volatile weekly volume has been.

(a) **The time left until the outcome to the question is known:** Approximately 11 weeks (from October 10, 2026 to the conclusion of the week of December 21–27, 2026, when chart data updates).
(b) **The outcome if nothing changed:** If weekly usage remained at the late September 2026 level (~165.9 trillion tokens) without further growth, the outcome would be approximately 166,000,000,000,000 tokens (or slightly lower around 140–150T if accounting purely for Christmas week developer slowdown).
(c) **The outcome if the current trend continued:** If the trailing 4-week growth rate (~43% every 4 weeks) persisted over the next 12 weeks without significant plateauing, weekly volume in mid-December would reach roughly 480 trillion tokens, which—after a ~15% holiday week dip—would result in around 410,000,000,000,000 tokens.
(d) **The expectations of experts and markets:** Near-term prediction markets in October anticipate steady-to-flat weekly volume (~165–175T), while extrapolations spanning the full 12-week runway to late December generally expect 200–400 trillion tokens, reflecting both structural growth and a standard end-of-year activity reduction.
(e) **An unexpected scenario that results in a low outcome:** The popular free "Space Bunny Alpha" stealth model (accounting for nearly ~39T tokens) is discontinued without an immediate replacement, major API providers cut pricing on direct endpoints disincentivizing routing through OpenRouter, and Christmas week causes a sharper-than-expected >30% seasonal slump, bringing volume down to ~120–140 trillion tokens.
(f) **An unexpected scenario that results in a high outcome:** A wave of viral reasoning models or autonomous coding agent frameworks standardizing on OpenRouter, combined with heavily subsidized or free new frontier models during Q4, drives exponential compounding above 50% monthly, pushing holiday week volume above 550 trillion tokens despite seasonal headwinds.
